newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey signs $13.5 bln deal to get Gazprom gas.
newsitem.headline: Turkey signs $13.5 bln deal to get Gazprom gas.

text.p: Turkey signed a landmark $13.5 billion agreement with Russia'a gas giant Gazprom to get natural gas over 25 years from 1997, senior Turkish officials said.

"The total value of the project is about $13.5 billion and it is a 25-year agreement starting from this year," Mustafa Murathan, head of Turkey's state pipeline concern Botas, told reporters after signing the deal with Gazprom head Rem Vyahirev in Istanbul.
Vyahirev said the deal would enable Turkey to tap Russian gas, presently at six billion cubic metres (bcm) annually, at gradually increasing amounts that will reach 30 bcm by 2010.

"This is final stage of the big project that we have begun sometime ago. The sums involved in this agreement are really big sums. We are going to increase the present six bcm to 30 bcm by 2010," he told reporters.
